candidate_order: current physical owner; successor request order inherited from static-input initial scheduler; resource key breaks tie; at most one commit per boundary
release_condition: Clear in release_theory.md; no vehicle-specific trigger times or fixed duration cuts
candidate_start_order: integers max(actual_k, own approach_end) through previous service_start-1, capped by initial_B0 checks
window_order: ascending actual k after event; >=2 nonzero-v vehicles with effective>=.02 and certified energy descent + both source phase models
numerical_events: first two successful releases; skip already occupied numerical control boundaries
retry: one attempt per actual history/contract/proposal; then execute old input, reevaluate only with new history or relevant frame
